info.name: Payment Scan to Pay API
info.description:
Coins.ph Partner Integration API v2.7

## Authentication
All requests must include the following headers:
- `X-COINS-APIKEY`: Your API key
- `Timestamp`: Unix timestamp of the request
- `Signature`: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request

Requests and webhook payloads must be signed using HMAC-SHA256 with the API secret.

## Environments
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.9001.pl-qa.coinsxyz.me`
- **Production**: `https://api.pro.coins.ph`

Contact Support:
 Name: Coins.ph Tech Ops
 Email: tech_ops@coins.ph

formdata.description: (Required) Unique order ID generated by the merchant.
(Required) Customer ID on the merchant side.
(Required) Default URL to redirect users based on registration results.
(Required) Customer's own IP address.
(Required) The source of the customer's device. (This can only be one of WEB,IOS,ANDROID)
(Required) Customer's user-agent.
(Required) First name.
(Required) Last name.
(Required) Gender: 0 - Other, 1 - Male, 2 - Female. (This can only be one of 0,1,2)
(Required) The format is: yyyy-MM-dd.
(Required) Current country of residence. Refer to CountryEnum, use the code field value.
(Required) Nationality. Refer to CountryEnum, use the code field value.
(Required) Current state (province) of residence.
(Required) Current city of residence.
(Required) Current residential address.
(Required) Current residence postal code.
(Required) Employment status. Refer to EmploymentStatusEnum. (This can only be one of employed,self_e,freelance,unemployed,retired,student)
(Required) Account purposes. (This can only be one of legal,crypto,both)
(Required) Type of ID, e.g.: passport. Refer to IdTypeEnum.
(Required) ID number.
(Required) ID expiration date, the format is: yyyy-MM-dd.
(Required) Image of the front of the id. Supported formats: jpg, png, jpeg. Max size: 2M.
(Required) Selfie photo. Supported formats: jpg, png, jpeg. Max size: 2M.
(Required) MD5 value of the frontIdImage file.
(Required) MD5 value of the facePhoto file.
Customer's email, at least one of the email or phone numbers must be provided.
The customer's mobile phone number must be formatted as [country code] [local number], for example: +63 9271234567.
User creation result notification URL.
URL for redirecting users after successful registration.
URL for redirecting upon registration failure.
URL for user cancellation of registration redirection.
Middle name.
Industry. If employmentStatus is employed, this field is required.
Company Name. If employmentStatus is employed, this field is required.
Position. If employmentStatus is employed, this field is required.
Backside photo of the evidence. Supported formats: jpg, png, jpeg. Max size: 2M.
MD5 value of the backIdImage file.
Scan to Pay need input scan_to_pay.
